|strategy=By Edward Tostanoski, Gold 3<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/specialedition/dark/small/huntingparty.html</ref>

Talk about a happy-trappy card! Now you can lure the Light Side into the dunes of [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]], 'miss' them with Sandwhirl, and then use your skiff-riding bounty hunters to drag them back to [[Jabba]]. This allows you to sprinkle a few bounty hunters and bounties in a [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] or Tusken deck, and get some Retireval without having to go all-out capture, as the Sandwhirls become your capture cards. Used on [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] (with [[Ice Storm (Dark){{!}}Ice Storm]]), it's less effective because there is no prison. But you don't expect much from a 7 Destiny card, and this one certainly can deliver more than most of the others.

Combos:

[[Hunting Party]] + Sandwhirl: First you spin them around, then you bag them. [[Hunting Party]] + Skiffs: As the missing people will be in the desert, most likely, you'll need some cheap, fast landspeed to shuttle your bounty hunters around in.
|combos=* [[Hunting Party]] + Sandwhirl First you spin them around, then you bag them.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Hunting%20Party</ref>
